lead.question: 穿牛仔裤遭冷遇的妇女，第二天靠什么让售货员爬进橱窗取衣？
lead.warmup: 一位穿牛仔裤的妇女站在高档商店的橱窗前，犹豫片刻后走了进去，想看看橱窗里那件连衣裙。势利的售货员轻蔑地瞥了她一眼，谎称衣服已经售出。第二天上午，她换上裘皮大衣、挎着手提包、拎着长柄伞重返商店，点名要同一件衣服。没认出她的售货员殷勤备至，费劲爬进橱窗取衣，她却看一眼就说不喜欢，最后才买下最初要看的那一件。
goals: 掌握 madam、jeans、hesitate、serve、scornfully、punish、fur、eager 等本课重点词汇
理解 dress in、in + 衣物表穿着，with + 随身物品表携带的介词用法
掌握现在分词短语替代状语从句（after / before / not + doing）的写法
掌握 make / let + 宾语 + 不带 to 的不定式，被动语态须还原 to
lead.summary: 本课是一个讽刺以貌取人的故事。语言点集中在：in jeans / dressed in a fur coat 表穿着，with a handbag 表随身携带；glance at、be eager to do、seek out、ask for、with great difficulty 等固定搭配；以及现在分词短语作状语替代时间或原因状语从句，还有 make sb do 中不定式不带 to 的规则。
lead.tips: 穿牛仔裤用 in jeans、提手提包用 with a handbag：in 表穿着，with 表携带或身体特征；make sb do 变被动必须补回 to。

questions.q: Did the woman get what she wanted?
questions.zh: 那位妇女得到她想要的东西了吗？
questions.a: Yes, she did. She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window and finally bought the dress she had first asked for.
questions.aZh: 得到了。她开心地让售货员把橱窗里几乎所有的东西都拿出来，最后买下了她最先要看的那一件。

questions.q: Why did the assistant tell the woman that the dress was sold on her first visit?
questions.zh: 第一次进店时，售货员为什么告诉她那件衣服已经卖出去了？
questions.a: Because he did not like the way she was dressed. Glancing at her scornfully, he lied that it was sold.
questions.aZh: 因为他不喜欢她那副打扮，轻蔑地看了她一眼，就谎称衣服已经售出。
questions.hint: did not like the way she was dressed 与 glancing at her scornfully。

questions.q: How was the woman dressed when she returned to the shop the following morning?
questions.zh: 第二天上午她回到商店时是怎样打扮的？
questions.a: She was dressed in a fur coat, with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
questions.aZh: 她穿了一件裘皮大衣，一只手拎着手提包，另一只手拿着一把长柄伞。
questions.hint: dressed in a fur coat 与 with 引导的伴随状语。

questions.q: What did the assistant have to do before the woman finally bought the dress?
questions.zh: 在她最后买下那件衣服之前，售货员不得不做什么？
questions.a: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress, and then brought almost everything in the window for her to look at.
questions.aZh: 他费了好大劲儿爬进橱窗取衣，之后几乎把橱窗里所有的东西都拿出来给她看。
questions.hint: climbed into the shop window、bring almost everything。

questions.q: 故事讽刺了什么？如果你是这位妇女，会怎样回应售货员的轻视？
questions.a: It mocks the snobbish assistant who judges customers by their clothes. One may answer that clothes do not show a person's worth; a polite but firm complaint to the manager would be a calmer way to answer such rudeness.
questions.aZh: 讽刺了以衣着取人的势利售货员。衣着不能代表一个人的价值；更冷静的做法是礼貌而坚定地向经理投诉。
questions.hint: 结合最后一句 her enjoyment 的讽刺意味。

exercises.q: 汉译英：她虽然犹豫了片刻，但终于还是走进了商店，要求看看橱窗里的那件衣服。
exercises.a: Though she hesitated for a moment, she finally went in and asked to see a dress that was in the window.

exercises.q: 填空：The assistant glanced ____ her scornfully and told her that the dress was sold.
句型转换：用现在分词短语改写 After she sought out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
exercises.a: After seeking out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
exercises.note: 连词 after 后接 seeking out。

exercises.q: 汉译英：那个售货员没有认出她是谁，这一回接待她的态度非常殷勤。
exercises.a: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
exercises.note: 分词否定式把 not 放在 realizing 之前。

exercises.q: 改错：She enjoyed herself making the assistant to bring almost everything in the window.
exercises.a: She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window.
exercises.note: make sb. do sth. 不定式不带 to。

exercises.q: 填空：She returned to the shop the following morning dressed ____ a fur coat, ____ a handbag in one hand.
exercises.note: in 表穿着，with 表携带。

exercises.q: 汉译英：警方正在找的那位妇女有一头红发，手里拿着一个红色手提包。
exercises.a: The woman the police are looking for has red hair and a red handbag in her hand.
exercises.note: 描写人用 with 引出外貌与随身特征。

quiz.q: 课文开头，那位妇女是怎样站在商店橱窗前的？
options: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
A woman in a fur coat stood at the window of an expensive shop.
A woman with a long umbrella walked past the shop.
A woman dressed in black sat near the window.
quiz.note: 首句为 A woman in jeans stood at the window…

quiz.q: 售货员第一次为什么说那件衣服已经卖出去了？
options: Because the dress had really been sold to another customer.
Because he did not like the way she was dressed.
Because the shop was about to close.
Because the dress in the window was not for sale.
quiz.note: did not like the way she was dressed。

quiz.q: 费了好大劲儿，他爬进橱窗去取那件衣服。对应的英文是哪一句？
options: With great ease, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
Without any difficulty, he reached the dress in the window.
In great difficulties, he broke the shop window to get the dress.
quiz.note: with great difficulty 表示费劲地。

quiz.q: 下列哪一句能正确替代 After she sought out the rude assistant 这一从句？
options: After she had seek out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
After seek out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
After seeking out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
After sought out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
quiz.note: 连词 after 后接现在分词。

quiz.q: 她开心地迫使售货员把橱窗里几乎所有的东西都拿出来。正确的英文表达是？
options: She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window.
She enjoyed herself making the assistant to bring almost everything in the window.
She enjoyed herself to make the assistant bring almost everything in the window.
She enjoyed to make the assistant brought almost everything in the window.
quiz.note: enjoy oneself doing sth.，且 make 后不定式不带 to。

quiz.q: 描写人物时，表示穿着一件裘皮大衣应使用哪个介词？
options: with a fur coat
in a fur coat
at a fur coat
on a fur coat
quiz.note: in 表穿着，with 表携带。
